title: Tentative idea: Holo conference in Kerala?

posts.topic_title: Tentative idea: Holo conference in Kerala?
posts.author: Kaveh
posts.post_subject: Tentative idea: Holo conference in Kerala?
posts.content_md:
Very tentatively, I would like to bounce the idea of a holo get together in Kerala, India, where our offices are. I am thinking around September next year. I have not discussed this with the ISDH organizers, but I just want to see what the general opinion is.

Kerala is one of the most attractive places in India to visit, with beaches and backwaters, relative equality among the population, almost full literacy, etc. A Google search will reveal more info.

in 2002 we organized a conference which went quite well, so we have experience of the organization. Here is a link to give you more info:

[http://www.tug.org.in/tug2002/](http://www.tug.org.in/tug2002/)

Any ideas welcome.
